verses.text: Paul and Timothy, bond-servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, including the overseers and deacons:
verses.textZh: 基督耶穌的僕人保羅和提摩太寫信給凡住腓立比、在基督耶穌裡的眾聖徒，和諸位監督，諸位執事。

verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textZh: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父並主耶穌基督歸與你們！

verses.text: I thank my God in all my remembrance of you,
verses.textZh: 我每逢想念你們，就感謝我的神；

verses.text: always offering prayer with joy in my every prayer for you all,
verses.textZh: 每逢為你們眾人祈求的時候，常是歡歡喜喜的祈求。

verses.text: in view of your participation in the gospel from the first day until now.
verses.textZh: 因為從頭一天直到如今，你們是同心合意的興旺福音。

verses.text: [For I am] confident of this very thing, that He who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Christ Jesus.
verses.textZh: 我深信那在你們心裡動了善工的，必成全這工，直到耶穌基督的日子。

verses.text: For it is only right for me to feel this way about you all, because I have you in my heart, since both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers of grace with me.
verses.textZh: 我為你們眾人有這樣的意念，原是應當的；因你們常在我心裡，無論我是在捆鎖之中，是辯明證實福音的時候，你們都與我一同得恩。

verses.text: For God is my witness, how I long for you all with the affection of Christ Jesus.
verses.textZh: 我體會基督耶穌的心腸，切切的想念你們眾人；這是神可以給我作見證的。

verses.text: And this I pray, that your love may abound still more and more in real knowledge and all discernment,
verses.textZh: 我所禱告的，就是要你們的愛心在知識和各樣見識上多而又多，

verses.text: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, in order to be sincere and blameless until the day of Christ;
verses.textZh: 使你們能分別是非（或作：喜愛那美好的事），作誠實無過的人，直到基督的日子；

verses.text: having been filled with the fruit of righteousness which [comes] through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
verses.textZh: 並靠著耶穌基督結滿了仁義的果子，叫榮耀稱讚歸與神。

verses.text: Now I want you to know, brethren, that my circumstances have turned out for the greater progress of the gospel,
verses.textZh: 弟兄們，我願意你們知道，我所遭遇的事更是叫福音興旺，

verses.text: so that my imprisonment in [the cause of] Christ has become well known throughout the whole praetorian guard and to everyone else,
verses.textZh: 以致我受的捆鎖在御營全軍和其餘的人中，已經顯明是為基督的緣故。

verses.text: and that most of the brethren, trusting in the Lord because of my imprisonment, have far more courage to speak the word of God without fear.
verses.textZh: 並且那在主裡的弟兄多半因我受的捆鎖就篤信不疑，越發放膽傳神的道，無所懼怕。

verses.text: Some, to be sure, are preaching Christ even from envy and strife, but some also from good will;
verses.textZh: 有的傳基督是出於嫉妒紛爭，也有的是出於好意。

verses.text: the latter [do it] out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel;
verses.textZh: 這一等是出於愛心，知道我是為辯明福音設立的；

verses.text: the former proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition rather than from pure motives, thinking to cause me distress in my imprisonment.
verses.textZh: 那一等傳基督是出於結黨，並不誠實，意思要加增我捆鎖的苦楚。

verses.text: What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed; and in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will rejoice,
verses.textZh: 這有何妨呢？或是假意，或是真心，無論怎樣，基督究竟被傳開了。為此，我就歡喜，並且還要歡喜；

verses.text: for I know that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.textZh: 因為我知道，這事藉著你們的祈禱和耶穌基督之靈的幫助，終必叫我得救。

verses.text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will not be put to shame in anything, but [that] with all boldness, Christ will even now, as always, be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
verses.textZh: 照著我所切慕、所盼望的，沒有一事叫我羞愧。只要凡事放膽，無論是生是死，總叫基督在我身上照常顯大。

verses.text: For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain.
verses.textZh: 因我活著就是基督，我死了就有益處。

verses.text: But if [I am] to live [on] in the flesh, this [will mean] fruitful labor for me; and I do not know which to choose.
verses.textZh: 但我在肉身活著，若成就我工夫的果子，我就不知道該挑選甚麼。

verses.text: But I am hard-pressed from both [directions], having the desire to depart and be with Christ, for [that] is very much better;
verses.textZh: 我正在兩難之間，情願離世與基督同在，因為這是好得無比的。

verses.text: yet to remain on in the flesh is more necessary for your sake.
verses.textZh: 然而，我在肉身活著，為你們更是要緊的。

verses.text: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and continue with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
verses.textZh: 我既然這樣深信，就知道仍要住在世間，且與你們眾人同住，使你們在所信的道上又長進又喜樂，

verses.text: so that your proud confidence in me may abound in Christ Jesus through my coming to you again.
verses.textZh: 叫你們在基督耶穌裡的歡樂，因我再到你們那裡去，就越發加增。

verses.text: Only conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or remain absent, I will hear of you that you are standing firm in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.textZh: 只要你們行事為人與基督的福音相稱，叫我或來見你們，或不在你們那裡，可以聽見你們的景況，知道你們同有一個心志，站立得穩，為所信的福音齊心努力。

verses.text: in no way alarmed by [your] opponents-- which is a sign of destruction for them, but of salvation for you, and that [too], from God.
verses.textZh: 凡事不怕敵人的驚嚇，這是證明他們沉淪，你們得救都是出於神。

verses.text: For to you it has been granted for Christ's sake, not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for His sake,
verses.textZh: 因為你們蒙恩，不但得以信服基督，並要為他受苦。

verses.text: experiencing the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear [to be] in me.
verses.textZh: 你們的爭戰，就與你們在我身上從前所看見、現在所聽見的一樣。
